 Fort Bend County District Court
 Cause No. 2023-CV-0016
 Jennifer Tyler, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
12-5-23
Counsel for defendant:
Marilyn Fox, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition, except those allegations
specifically admitted herein, and demands strict proof thereof as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
For its first affirmative defense, Defendant asserts that the injuries and damages claimed by Plaintiff were not
proximately caused by any negligence on the part of Defendant. The collision occurred at a low rate of speed, and the
forces involved were insufficient to produce the injuries alleged, or the alleged injuries pre-existed the occurrence or
arose from unrelated causes.
For its second affirmative defense, Defendant asserts proportionate responsibility under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil
Practice and Remedies Code. To the extent the trier of fact finds Plaintiff was negligent, that negligence must be
compared against any responsibility assigned to Defendant, and any recovery must be reduced or barred
accordingly.
For its third affirmative defense, Defendant asserts that Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by not following
reasonable medical advice, delaying treatment, or incurring medical expenses that are unreasonable or unnecessary.
Any recovery must be limited under Section 41.0105 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code to amounts
actually paid or incurred.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
